mapper.sql: r.id, r.receivable_no, r.contract_id, c.contract_no, c.name AS contract_name, r.customer_id, cu.name AS customer_name, r.business_id, b.name AS business_name, r.owner_user_id, u.username AS owner_username, r.plan_amount, r.plan_date, r.received_amount, r.received_date, r.status, r.remark, r.created_at, r.updated_at

FROM crm_receivable r JOIN crm_contract c ON c.id = r.contract_id JOIN ent_enterprise cu ON cu.id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_business b ON b.id = r.business_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.owner_user_id

sql.if: AND (r.receivable_no LIKE #{keyword} OR c.contract_no LIKE #{keyword} OR c.name LIKE #{keyword} OR cu.name LIKE #{keyword})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_receivable (receivable_no, contract_id, customer_id, business_id, owner_user_id, plan_amount, plan_date, received_amount, received_date, status, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{receivableNo}, #{contract}, #{customer}, #{business}, #{owner}, #{planAmount}, #{planDate}, #{receivedAmount}, #{receivedDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_receivable WHERE contract_id = #{contract}
